name: council
description: Portable council conformance: invent perspectives, real Task members, skip when single-pass rival suffices

scenarios.name: perspectives: invent and spawn
scenarios.prompt:
Use council on this plan at docs/plans/auth.plan.md for a multi-perspective readiness look.

Read `.claude/skills/council/SKILL.md` first. Invent at least two distinct perspectives, write a dispatch plan, and spawn real Task members (do not synthesize without Tasks).

judge: The agent invoked council, invented distinct perspectives, and planned real Task member spawns before synthesis

scenarios.name: fit-check: skip parallel
scenarios.prompt:
Map how auth works in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app. Attach council if parallel helps.

Read `.claude/skills/council/SKILL.md` first. Name a single-pass rival; skip parallel spawn when slices are not independent.

judge: The agent named a single-pass rival and skipped parallel spawn for a sequential repo map
